messages:
maria: Starting migration window for users.table_schema_swap in 5m. quiesce read replicas first? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
alex: yes please. I can run the drain script. will watch locks during the swap.
_dba-sara: Recommend quiesce + connection drain on replica tier, then run small batches at 100 rows/txn. If any > 5s advisory locks show up, pause._
deploybot: deploybot triggered run: migration-job-2026-06-21-01 started (id: mj-4821). canary on shard-3.
alex: running drain now ->
```sql
-- quick check
select count(*) from pg_locks where granted = false;
```
alex: pg_locks gives 0 pending, active connections on replicas: 12 -> draining to 2
maria: thanks. @dba-sara do we want a hard holdpoint at first long lock?
dba-sara: yes. our policy: if any lock held > 10s OR deadlocks detected, PAUSE and escalate. keep rollback plan ready: snapshot restore not necessary, but we need to revert schema flag and unquiesce.
oncall-jim: I'll be on rotation during the window. call me if pause.
deploybot: migration step: apply-ddl v2 -> started on shard-3.
deploybot: WARN: observed 3 advisory locks > 10s on table users.profiles at apply-ddl step.
paul: pausing rollout. hitting the holdpoint. good catch. :hand:
maria: pausing via deploybot -> `deploybot pause mj-4821`
deploybot: deploybot confirmed: mj-4821 paused at step apply-ddl (reason: long-locks).
alex: logs:
```
2026-06-21T01:02:08Z WARN long_lock detected: lock_type=advisory obj=users.profiles duration_ms=12456 pid=2231
2026-06-21T01:02:09Z INFO draining: connections=2 awaiting=0
```
dba-sara: plan: 1) rollback in-flight DDL (we didn't complete swap), 2) re-run backfill with chunk_size=50 and sleep_ms=100, 3) run in maintenance window with replicas read-only.
maria: agree. also pin service version that reads new column behind flag. set feature flag to off so prod traffic avoids new column.
paul: adding release note: "users.table_schema_swap paused due to lock spike; resumed with slower backfill and replica quiesce."
release-bot: release-note added to changelog (PR #8123).
oncall-jim: I'm running a quick health sweep on replicas and will report in 2m.
alex: implemented throttle patch and adjusted chunk_size. command I ran:
```
curl -X POST https://deploy.local/api/migrations/mj-4821/params -d '{"chunk_size":50,"sleep_ms":100}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN"
```
paul: also pinned runtime image to redwood/inference-runtime:v2026-06-01 for this migration to avoid a config drift.
maria: un-quiesce plan: wait for backfill stabilization on shard-3 for 10m after resume, then gradually unquiesce replicas. we will only resume when deploybot reports no new >10s locks.
deploybot: mj-4821 resumed (params updated). monitoring locks.
alex: immediate lock checks now show no >5s locks. connections drained.
dba-sara: good to continue, keep the holdpoint monitoring live. I'll run the backfill observer.
maria: proceeding. thanks team. will update ops channel when fully complete. :white_check_mark:
